TSQLCommand.CommandText:
ALTER XML SCHEMA COLLECTION [Person].[AdditionalContactInfoSchemaCollection] ADD '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <xsd:schema targetNamespace="http://schemas.microsoft.com/sqlserver/2004/07/adventure-works/ContactRecord" elementFormDefault="qualified" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/sqlserver/2004/07/adventure-works/ContactRecord" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" >
<xsd:element name="ContactRecord" > <xsd:complexType mixed="true" > <xsd:choice minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" > <xsd:any processContents="strict" namespace="http://schemas.microsoft.com/sqlserver/2004/07/adventure-works/ContactTypes" /> </xsd:choice> <xsd:attribute name="date" type="xsd:date" /> </xsd:complexType> </xsd:element> </xsd:schema>'
